title: mimid admin: list and revoke provider tokens (purple-mimi prerequisite)
description: Mark 2026-11-22 (purple-mimi Q7): mimid admin issues bearer tokens but cannot list or revoke them. Add per-token names/ids and last-used, 'mimid admin <cfg> tokens <userUri>', 'revoke-token <id>', local-route equivalents; revocation takes effect at once (cache invalidation) and closes that token's EventSource and live-stream connections. Prerequisite for purple-mimi (each Pidgin holds a provider token).
close_reason: Built in feaf1868 (branch purple-prereqs): token ids, names and last use (migration 0017); mimid admin token <userUri> [name], tokens <userUri>, revoke-token <id>; local routes GET/POST /local/v1/users/{user}/tokens and POST /local/v1/tokens/{id}/revoke; no validity cache, revocation announced on a store watch channel that ends the token's EventSource streams and closes its live-stream connections at once. Tests in mimid-server store, jmap_auth, jmap_projection, live_stream, local_routes.
